fields.v: Spec-first (authors' wording: 'PRD-driven development', 'PRD-driven incremental development in enterprise brownfield repositories'; a standardized PRD with goals, scope, functional requirements, business rules, technical constraints and acceptance criteria is written before implementation and given to the agent as the task input, not maintained afterwards)
fields.quote: Agents receive the same PRD and base, without reference patches, source conversations, or Code Points.
fields.why: A structured requirements document written before the code and handed to the agent for one task matches Böckeler's spec-first level, so 'not classifiable' may understate it.
fields.doubt: O agente recebe um PRD estruturado (objetivos, âmbito, requisitos, regras, critérios de aceitação) antes de escrever código e o PRD não é mantido depois. Isto parece 'spec-first' de Böckeler e não 'não classificável'. Vê a pág. 2 e o prompt na pág. 19 e decide o nível.
